translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: Rom
book.title: ROM Pol Rom Biynimb Kuyip Minj Tikak.

content: Gor Kor Nuk Ak Yipund Giy Nep Giniŋgamb
Nimb biynimb gunap kuyip aŋgjiwiy, yenen tap siy tap timey gipay apim ak pen; key kunep gipim ak, Gor niŋek kinjeŋ nimb bap ma mindip.
Gor bi minim niŋind nep aŋgiy kor gip ak; biynimb timey gipay gok niŋek, minim yomb yimb ak mindip.
Pen nimb kunep giyiŋg, kuyip nep aŋgjiwpim ak, gos yerip niŋbim? Gor chinup kor ma giniŋgamb aŋgiy niŋbim?
Akaŋ; Gor bi tep biynimb simb niŋiy dip ak, nimbip per kond mindek, nup niŋem bi yikop bap rek ayek, tap siy tap timey gok ginep mindpim?

Pen gos kisenimb ar ak niŋun aŋgiy ma niŋbim. Nup alemb alemb ñiy, tap timey gok nep gi mindpim ak, miñ saw mon saw rek, ar koyoŋ koyoŋ yiw gip. Biynimb giniŋgambay giniŋgambay rek niŋiy, kor giniŋgamb ñin ak, tap timey gipim gok maŋgiysek miseŋ aŋgyikiy, yiwur yomb yimb ñiniŋgamb.
Pen biynimb mumbwak kisenimb ak diy, perper mindon aŋgiy mindrep giy gey amjap gok kuyip gek, nuk yip perper mindeniŋgambay.
Pen minim nup ak kirgiy, gosimb nup ma niŋiy, mumbwak kiyk key anep gos niŋniŋgambay gok, kuyip miluk niŋiy, yiwur yomb yimb ak ñiniŋgamb.
Pen Jiwda biynimb gok sek, Jiwda biynimb mer gok sek timey ar ak geniŋgambay, kuyip aŋgek am kosyam mindiy, gospar yimb ayiŋg mindeniŋgambay.
Pen mindrep gey, Gor miñmon biyoŋ kuyip wasemb yimb ayek, nuk yip mindrep yimb giniŋgambay.
Kun ak nuk, pis bap akaŋ pis bap ma amniŋgamb; yipund giy nep niŋiy, biynimb gok kuyip tuŋgasik keykey ayniŋgamb.

Biynimb Gor low minim nind ma niŋiy, tap siy tap timey giniŋgambay gok, kor ar ak key giy miñmon timey amniŋgambay; biynimb Gor low ak niŋiy, tap siy tap timey giniŋgambay gok, kor ar ak key giy, miñmon timey amniŋgambay.
Pen biynimb low minim nup ak niŋiy aŋgip rek gipay gok nep, “Biynimb suŋrep yand aŋgniŋgamb.” Biynimb low minim nup ak niŋiy, minim nep aŋg aŋg, won ak kirpay gok kuyip, “Biynimb yand” ma aŋgniŋgamb.
Biynimb Gor low minim ak niŋiy mer; mindrep gun aŋgiy, tap siy tap timey kuŋay ma gipay gok, Gor kuyip gos tep ñek mey kun gipay.
Gipay kun ak, ñin gunap gi dand amiy, namb kiyk biyaŋ, tep gispun aŋgiy niŋbay; ñin gunap gi dand amiy, timey gispun aŋgiy niŋbay.

Pen Gor Jiysis Krays nup aŋgek kor giniŋgamb ñin ak, tap siy tap timey gi weygipay gok aŋgyikniŋg, gos niŋbay kun ak rek kuyip kor gek, yiwur yomb yimb ak diniŋgambay. Pen yand minim tep nup ak aŋgñi taŋgyiŋg, per kun ak rek apiyn.
Chin Jiwda Kay Low Minim Niŋbun Rek, Suŋ-tep Mindpun Aŋgyak
Pen nimb Jiwda biynimb gok, yimb nimbik ak key dand aranyiŋg apim, “Chin Gor low minim niŋrep gipun ak, biynimb nuk yimb mindpun.
Ñapan sikoy miŋg mindiy, chinup per Gor low minim ak aŋgñey, nup tep gip ar ak, tep ma gip ar ak aŋgiy niŋiy, nup tep gip ar anep gipun apim.”
Pen minim ar bap apim, “Biynimb ma niŋbay gok kuyip aŋgñirep giy, windin koy kisyim wip rek mindpay gok kuyip aŋgñirep giy,
low minim ma niŋbay gok kuyip aŋgñirep giy, ñapan sikoy gok kuyip aŋgñirep giy gipun apim.” Apim kun ak, “Low minim niŋbun rek, minim tep bap ma niŋbun mer; maŋgiysek niŋdipun anep mindip apim.”
Nimb low minim ak niŋiy, biynimb okok kuyip aŋgñimbim ak pen; nimb key low ar kun gok timbrikpim! “Tap ma siy dinimimb apim” ak pen; nimb key siy dipim.
Biyn siy bi siy ma ginimimb apim ak pen; nimb key biyn siy bi siy gipim. “Tap monmon okok gor rek ma aŋgniŋnimimb apim” ak pen; nimb korip aŋgniŋbay miŋgan ak amiy, tap daypay gok gunap siy dipim.
Yimb nimbik ak key dand araniy apim, “Chin Gor low ak niŋrep yimb gipun apim” ak pen; minim nup ak timbrikpim rek, yimb nup taw achip achip gipim.
Kun ak mindrep ma giy, Mosis Baybol buk ak tikiy aŋgak rek nep gipim. Nuk aŋgak:

content.text: “Nimb Jiwda biynimb, Gor low minim niŋbun apim ak pen; nimb key mindrep ma gipim rek, biynimb yikop gok Gor nup aŋgjiwpay aŋgak.”

content: Chin Jiwda biynimb gok, Gor biynimb nuk mindon aŋgiy, ñi gok tikyiŋg, per kumbak tikpun. Pen Gor minim nup ak timbrikiy, key niŋniŋgambun rek giniŋgambun ak; biynimb yikop okok nimb, Gor nup gosimb ma niŋbay rek ak mindoniŋgambun.
Kun ak rek biynimb kumbak ma tikpay gok, minim aŋgip rek geniŋgambay, kuyip kunep direp giniŋgamb.
Chin Jiwda kay Baybol buk niŋyiŋg, kumbak tikyiŋg gipun ak pen; monmon gipun rek, biynimb yikop gok mindrep giyakniŋ, chin kuyip niŋon nambiŋ giniŋgamb.
Kumbak tikiy, “Chin Gor biynimb nuk yipund giy yimb apun” ak pen; biynimb nuk ma mindpun.
Biynimb nuk mindpay gok, Gor Kawnan ak gos ñek, nup gosimb niŋiy aŋgip rek gipay. Gipay kun ak, biynimb niŋey yimb ma mindip; pen Gor niŋek yimb mindip.
